scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.dev: node scripts/bootstrap.mjs --quiet && sh -c 'trap "kill 0" INT TERM EXIT; APP_ORIGIN=${APP_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:5173} PORT=${API_PORT:-5050} pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev & PORT=5173 BASE_PATH=/ API_PROXY_TARGET=http://127.0.0.1:5050 pnpm --filter @workspace/career-mentor run dev & wait'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/career-mentor build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server build
scripts.verify: pnpm run build && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
